sections.html: Projection accuracy (every overridden player, bet or not) converges fastest — watch the log-lik gain and its se. Bets split overridden vs model-only below. Overridden plays are excluded from the w_model anchor fit.

sections.note: Each row trains on every season before it, early-stops on the last six weeks of the prior season, and scores the test season once. Near-line metrics are at the half-point line nearest each λ — the number that prices props. +LEVEL = production config with the in-season level correction. PIT tails: 0.20 is ideal.
sections.title: MODEL VALIDATION — EXPANDING-SEASON HOLDOUT (nfl_model.py train)

sections.note: Out-of-sample rows only. BIAS = mean(λ − actual); positive = model too high on this player. Z = bias ÷ its standard error — ⚑ marks n ≥ 16 and |Z| ≥ 2, a systematic miss rather than variance. MAE/√λ is volume-adjusted so LBs and DL are comparable (≈0.85–1.10 is normal).
